description: This file extends the AttributedString class with a method to extract sentences, optionally limited by maximum length, incorporating Natural Language processing and audio time range annotations.

classes.name: AttributedString
classes.description: An extension of the native AttributedString class, adding the sentences(maxLength:) method for sentence tokenization.

methods.name: sentences
methods.description: Returns an array of AttributedString segments, each representing a sentence or a segment of a sentence limited by maxLength, with associated audio time range attributes.
